abstract: Nine of twenty-four mediastinal tumors showed cystic lesions were operated at Kinki University Hospital. These nine mediastinal cysts included 5 of thymic cysts, 3 teratomas and one pericardial cyst. By the preoperative imagings, thymic cysts showed a smooth wall and homogenous content with water density. Teratoma consisted of cystic and solid parts, and the irregular thickness of the wall was found. One of these teratomas was ruptured into the pleural cavity, it has been proposed that digestive enzyme derived from pancreatic tissue with Langerhans island caused autolysis and necrosis with result in rupture. Pericardial cyst located at cardiophrenic angle mostly and which is useful on diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 近畿大学病院で手術された縦隔腫瘍24例のうち9例が嚢胞性病変を示した。これら9例の嚢胞性縦隔病変には、胸腺嚢胞5例、奇形腫3例、心膜嚢胞1例が含まれていた。術前画像では、胸腺嚢胞は平滑な壁と水様濃度の均一な内容物を示した。奇形腫は嚢胞部と充実部からなり、壁の厚さが不規則であった。奇形腫の1例は胸膜腔へ破裂した。膵臓のランゲルハンス島を含む膵組織由来の消化酵素が自己融解と壊死を引き起こし、破裂をもたらしたと推測されている。心膜嚢胞は主に心横隔膜角に位置し、診断に有用である。
